headline: The Knowledge & RAG area covers codebase memory, graph visualisation and semantic retrieval; the code clearly backs the graph and codebase-memory pieces, while six of nine tickets — mostly the retrieval, packaging and evaluation work — could not be confirmed from the code examined.
what_is_there: There is working support for building a persistent, indexed memory of a codebase and for turning its structure into an interactive graph that opens in the browser, with zoom, search, legend and clickable nodes. Settings exist to enable indexing and point at the memory service, and the graph structure data feeds directly into the viewer.
what_is_unclear: The analysis could not settle the knowledge-graph-from-file-content work, semantic similarity search, the portable knowledge pack specification, the standardised way agents gather context from retrieval/search/tools, the source/citation/project-isolation upgrade, or the plan to measure semantic search quality including Japanese. This is because the files it read did not cover those topics, not because evidence showed them absent.
suggested_action: Ask the team which parts of the retrieval and knowledge-packaging stack already exist so a targeted second pass can be run on those specific components.
